content: Do not load memory/shared.json with hippo import --file: it parses the JSON as plain text and writes one memory per line, flooding the store with fragment entries such as a bare key string. Use scripts/memory_absorb.py, which compares normalized content against the local export and calls hippo remember once per missing entry. It is idempotent.

Out-of-sample window for this entry: with an EIA-860M history start of 2022-01-03 the mandated rule (most recent 20 percent, or 2 years, whichever is shorter) gives about 2025-10-20 to 2026-10-02 out of sample, and 2022-01-03 to 2025-10-19 in sample.

Repo: https://github.com/sebastbernal2-ship-it/gqh-delivery-gap (public, main). Single source of truth for the GQH 2026 systematic trading entry. Owners: docs/00-brief.md holds the track facts and rubric; docs/01-idea.md the delivery-gap strategy; docs/02-system.md the execution plan; docs/03-decisions.md the append-only decision ledger; docs/04-memory.md the memory protocol; docs/reviews/ the team critiques; results/README.md the frozen artifact envelope (e1.json, e2.json, e3.json, e4.json, costs.json); OWNERS.md the one-writer-per-path map. Session start: make sync, which pulls and absorbs the team's shared memory, then read docs/00 through 03. Write a shareable memory with: make remember M=... (tags it gqh). Share it with: make share, which filters and writes memory/SHARED.md and memory/shared.json. Gates: make test, make secrets, make check.

Delivery-gap state variable is built and running (src/delivery/, results/e0_state.json, make all runs it in about 52 seconds). Measurement rule: cohort = a monthly EIA-860M vintage; only units promised inside [cohort, cohort+12 months] are measured; the realization vintage is the earliest at least horizon+6 months later, so cohorts are comparable. Three comparable cohorts: 2024-01 gives W1 3.11 months, 2024-07 gives 2.70, 2025-01 gives 2.74; median delay 1 to 2 months; cancellation share 2.4 to 4.4 percent by MW. Two bugs were caught by sanity checks: including far-future planned projects understated delay and inflated cancellations to 32 percent, and measuring every cohort against one latest vintage mixed measured delays with right-censored ones. Technology check now passes: with the window applied, natural gas combined cycle shows zero cancellations, which the un-windowed version reported at 52 percent. EIA September 2026 vintage returns HTTP 503, so August 2026 is the latest usable realization vintage.
